{{Quote|Ask the Council for Master Alaqua's "Meditations on a Padawan's Journey." Another perspective might help you.|The [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Alaqua''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who wrote ''[[Meditations on a Padawan's Journey]]'' sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
